lead.headline: Europe Will Join Ukraine Talks in Abu Dhabi After Missiles Hit Kyiv
lead.deck: Officials from Ukraine, Russia and the United States meet in the United Arab Emirates on Tuesday and Wednesday.
body: Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine. Overnight into Saturday, Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones, and President Volodymyr Zelensky said all 36 missiles were aimed at Kyiv and the area around it. Nine people were wounded, including one child. Only four missiles were shot down, he said.
Zelensky said the energy system was again the main target. Kyiv had trouble with electricity, water and heating.

The talks are in Abu Dhabi, in the United Arab Emirates. Ukraine, Russia and the United States meet there on Tuesday and Wednesday, the first US-led round since February. On Sunday, France’s foreign minister said European officials will go too. Russia had ruled out a European role.

world.headline: Atoms on China’s Space Station Get Colder Than Ever Before
world.deck: Scientists chilled about 20,000 atoms to a record low.
body: Slow atoms are cold atoms. Scientists on China’s Tiangong space station cooled about 20,000 rubidium atoms to about 10 picokelvins. That is 10 trillionths of a kelvin.
Lasers held the atoms in a trap and slowed them. On Earth gravity makes atom clouds sag, which limits cooling, so orbit helps.
The result was reported on 5 November in the journal Science. The old records were 52 picokelvins on the International Space Station and 38 in a drop tower.
